name: Yearl
description: Hero that can cliffwalk, fire a disrupting projectile, throw sticky bombs, and become drop a mine while becoming invisible.

abilities.name: Disrupting Shot
abilities.description: The blast deals 30 damage, slows enemies, and prevents them from using attacking or using abilities for 3s.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.description:
Stealth and +40% movement speed for 10s.
Leaves a mine at location. Only one mine can be active.
(30 damage, 3s duration slow)
abilities.details:
Mine deals {Damage} damage and slows for {Seconds} seconds.
Only one mine can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.description: Throw a sticky bomb. After {Delay} seconds it explodes dealing {Damage} damage and stunning them for {Stun time} seconds.
abilities.details:
Explodes after delay or on unit death.
Damage radius increases until explosion.
